name: Mechet
source:
BALLS. The Brainwave Ascension Launch-Liftoff Spaceship, basically the best ship ever. Chet thought he'd be flying solo but now there's another guy?!

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/mechet]Itch.io[/url]]

BALLS號，全稱「腦波升空發射起飛宇宙飛船」，基本上就是有史以來最棒的飛船。切特以為自己會獨自出航，結果居然還有另一個男人？！

[摘自[url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/mechet]Itch.io[/url]]
